lines.en: Koce the barber, the musician,
Koce the barber, the passionate one.

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце не јади расол со месо (јок!),
lines.lat: Koce, Koce ne jadi rasol so meso (jok!),
lines.en: Koce, Koce does not eat salted meat (no!),

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце не јади грав со пастрма.
lines.lat: Koce, Koce ne jadi grav so pastrma.
lines.en: Koce, Koce does not eat beans with preserved meat.
(Oh, tasty beans!)
Koce the barber, the musician,
Koce the barber, the passionate one.

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце ми јади гаска печена, еј,
lines.lat: Koce, Koce mi jadi gaska pečena, ej,
lines.en: Koce eats roasted goose, hey,
goose roasted on a spit turned.
Goose, goose roasted, on a spit turned
with raisins the whole goose filled.
(Koce with the large moustache, who likes only the good things!)
Koce the barber, the musician,
Koce the barber, the passionate one.

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце не пие мека ракија (јок!),
lines.lat: Koce, Koce ne pie meka rakija (jok!),
lines.en: Koce, Koce does not drink mild rakiya (no!),

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце не пие вино кисело.
lines.lat: Koce, Koce ne pie vino kiselo.
lines.en: Koce, Koce does not drink sour wine.
(Hey, Koce is choosy about what he eats,
Koce is choosy about what he drinks,

lines.cyr: знае многу работи, е хе хеј!)
lines.lat: znae mnogu raboti, e he hej!)
lines.en: he is a real gourmet, hey, hey!)
Koce the barber, the musician,
Koce the barber, the passionate one.

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце си пие лута ракија, хеј,
lines.lat: Koce, Koce si pie luta rakija, hej,
lines.en: Koce, Koce drinks strong rakiya, hey,

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце си пие вино лежано.
lines.lat: Koce, Koce si pie vino ležano.
lines.en: Koce, Koce drinks aged wine.

lines.cyr: Море Коце, Коце си пие лута ракија, хеј,
lines.lat: More Koce, Koce si pie luta rakija, hej,
lines.en: Koce, Koce drinks strong rakiya, hey,

lines.cyr: Коце, Коце си пие вино лежано.
lines.lat: Koce, Koce si pie vino ležano.
lines.en: Koce, Koce drinks aged wine.
If you want him to play for you,

lines.cyr: дајте му на Коцета што ќе посака.
lines.lat: dajte mu na Koceta što ḱe posaka.
lines.en: give Koce what he wants.

lines.cyr: Коце ќе ви засвири и ќе запее,
lines.lat: Koce ḱe vi zasviri i ḱe zapee,
lines.en: Koce will play and sing for you,

lines.cyr: старо, младо на оро ќе развесели, хеј!
lines.lat: staro, mlado na oro ḱe razveseli, hej!
lines.en: old and young will rejoice in the dance, hey!
